# 02 - The CRM, capability by capability

What works today, what is left, and what each remaining item waits on. The letter after each remaining item is its
group in doc 03: **A** complete the CRM, **B** ready for go-live (both in this package), **C** separately priced
option, **D** optional tidy-up, **E** later, **H** waiting on a PBL decision, **I** waiting on an outside system.

This was checked against the code and the records on the date of this copy. If you find a capability that works
differently from what is written here, tell us: the code is what runs, but the difference may be a defect.

| Capability | Works today | Left to do | Record |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Leads** | Record, list (newest first) and update Leads; follow-up activities with dates; the qualify-or-close decision; converting a qualified Lead into an Account and an Opportunity | Conversion always makes a new Account: look for the existing one by PAN first (A). Warn of a duplicate Lead (A). A closed Lead can still be reopened, and a very long company name causes an error (A). Reminders and assignment, through notifications (A). Follow-up activities merge into the conversation log (A) | `docs/agent/contracts/lead-contract.md`; slices 2A-2E, 3D |
| **Accounts** | Create and list; contacts, addresses, PAN, GST numbers that Finance verifies, classification, documents | No way yet to edit an Account's details or status, or to edit or remove a contact, address or GST number (A). A GST number Sales entered cannot later be verified (A). One PAN per Account, and each GST number checked against it (A). The owner is set by typing the person's user ID code - needs a person picker (D) | `docs/agent/contracts/account-business-party-contract.md`; slice 1 |
| **PAN and GST validation (SurePass)** | Nothing yet; numbers are checked for format, and Finance verifies by hand | Verification states, an exception queue, retries and a manual route for long outages, priced as its own line (I) | `docs/agent/contracts/account-identity-validation-contract.md` (AIV-001); ADR-015, ADR-022 |
| **Credit amount and credit days** | Nothing yet | Assessed by the credit assessor, approved by the Department Head or Managing Director, with review dates - part of the credit exposure line (A) | `docs/agent/contracts/account-credit-profile-contract.md` (ACP-001) |
| **Opportunities** | Create, list, update, stage; repair a missing Account link | "Won" and "closed" are never set, and offer outcomes do not update the Opportunity (A; the rules for when are for PBL to confirm, and you may propose them) | `docs/agent/contracts/opportunity-contract.md` |
| **Offers: kinds and statuses** | Base Offer, Supplementary Offer and Change Quotation; status changes checked on the server; one active Base Offer per Opportunity, enforced by the database; an out-of-date save refused rather than overwriting a colleague's | A review date for a sent offer with no expiry date (ADR-027), within the credit exposure line (A) | `docs/agent/contracts/commercial-offer-contract.md`; slices 4A-4F, 6K-6M, CS-05a |
| **Offer lines and pricing** | Lines keep their identity for life; quantity times rate; INR by default, or USD, GBP or EUR, never added together | The offer's header value is not reconciled with its lines, and reports use the header (A). GST calculation (E) | Slice 4E; `docs/agent/contracts/commercial-offer-contract.md` |
| **Market and basis rates** | Operations or Sales record market rates per line, with vendor quotes and history; one is chosen as the line's basis | Only Sales to choose the basis rate (A). Markup shown per line, with the approval rule (A). Rate master and historical rates from the existing ERP system (E) | Slice 4G |
| **Versions** | A sent offer is never edited: a change is a new version (v2, v3...). The version it replaces is marked replaced only when the new one is sent; one abandoned before sending replaces nothing | Small leftovers (D) | Slice 9F |
| **Before sending** | A checklist of what an offer needs; evidence recorded; hard checks before it can be sent; an event when it is committed | Approval when markup is below the threshold (A). An export of the offer in JSON or XML for customer templates, portals and auctions (A). Proof files kept in SharePoint (C) | Slices 6H-6J |
| **Quotation** | Generated from a template; each issued version frozen and fingerprinted; approval for issue; totals per currency | The approval setting - none or one, never the preparer (A). A PDF made by the server (E) | Slice 9E |
| **Terms and conditions** | Fifteen sample clauses, read-only; attached to the offer as a whole | A clause library people can manage; terms on each line; approval of a material change (A). PBL supplies the legal wording | `docs/agent/contracts/terms-and-conditions-contract.md`; slices 6E-6G |
| **Customer response** | Award, loss, or one of five other answers (revision requested, clarification, on hold, pending, other), recorded under the offer's lock; the latest response counts; no "lost" once a Work Order exists | A fixed list of reasons for a loss (A). The unawarded balance leaving exposure, within the credit exposure line (A) | Slices 6L, 6M; CS-04 |
| **Credit exposure on an offer** | A manual credit-review note; "on hold" stops the offer being sent | The exposure figure and gate, and the move from potential to firm at the Work Order - the credit exposure line (A) | `docs/agent/contracts/credit-exposure-contract.md` (CEX-001); ADR-024, ADR-027 |
| **Documents** | Upload and download, with rights per kind of record; stored on the server's disk behind a storage layer built to take SharePoint later | Delete, and view safe kinds in the browser (B). Upload on the Lead and Opportunity pages (D). SharePoint (C) | `docs/agent/contracts/documents.md`; ADR-036 |
| **Conversation log** | Conversations recorded from the Account, Lead and Opportunity pages (the server also accepts offers and Work Orders); a repeat carrying the same request key is not duplicated | Lead follow-up activities merged in (A). The screen to send a request key; paging and filters on screen (D). Capturing email and WhatsApp (E) | `docs/agent/contracts/interaction-contract.md` (INT-001) |
| **Reports** | Four dashboard reports | Views per person once PBL decides who sees what (B, H). Date filters and export (E) | `docs/agent/contracts/reports-contract.md` |
| **Users, roles and sign-in** | Six roles; 55 permissions, checked on the server on every business route (health and platform-status addresses and a person's own profile are recorded exceptions; annex A, CS-08); a hardened sign-in (lock-out after failed attempts, password rules); users managed with a command-line tool | Managing users from the screens (B). A safer sign-in and lock-out (B). Who sees which records (B, H). Single sign-on and two-step sign-in (C). The organisation-authority engine is built but dormant (C) | `docs/agent/contracts/organization-authority-authorization-contract.md` (ORA-001); `docs/continuity/TB1_204A_SIGN_IN_HARDENING.md` |
| **Approvals and notifications** | Nothing yet | The approvals facility and in-app notifications (A). Email and SMS (C) | APR-001, NTF-001 |
| **Audit** | A business event on every change, guarded against carrying passwords or keys; an event history screen for Admin and Management Read-Only users | A tracking id and versions on events (C) | `docs/agent/contracts/workflow-and-events.md`; `docs/agent/architecture/MCF_ADOPTION_RECORD.md` |
| **The handoff to a Work Order** | Built and frozen (doc 05) | A request key and a tracking id, agreed for later (C) | Doc 05 |
| **Work Order amendments** | A customer's later amendment is recorded and checked, but not applied to the Work Order | Applying it belongs to Hiring, later (decision D-07) | `docs/agent/contracts/work-order-amendment-contract.md` |
| **Testing** | About 3,500 server tests, about 600 screen-logic tests, about 25 browser walk-throughs, one combined result on every change | Screen-level tests (A). A test of upgrading a database that already holds data (B; annex A, TB1-701) | `docs/agent/TESTING_STRATEGY.md` |
| **Running it** | PBL's test sites only; a backup before every upgrade; a recorded way to undo a release | Production in PBL's Azure account (B) | `db/notes/migration-rules.md`; doc 10 |
